lead.t:
Patients with mild acute pancreatitis:
● Bowel rest (NPO).
● IV fluids​.​ ​“Correct electrolyte abnormalities.”
● Pain control.
● Nasogastric tube. ​“If severe nausea/vomiting or ileus present.”
